crossRefs.note: to know wisdom and instruction; to discern the words of understanding;
Good and upright is Yahweh, therefore he will instruct sinners in the way.
He will guide the humble in justice. He will teach the humble his way.
I will instruct you and teach you in the way which you shall go. I will counsel you with my eye on you.
I have more understanding than all my teachers, for your testimonies are my meditation.
Your word is a lamp to my feet, and a light for my path.
Cause me to hear your loving kindness in the morning, for I trust in you. Cause me to know the way in which I should…
A highway will be there, a road, and it will be called “The Holy Way”. The unclean shall not pass over it, but it will…
Yahweh, your Redeemer, the Holy One of Israel says: “I am Yahweh your God, who teaches you to profit, who leads you by…
Yahweh says, “Stand in the ways and see, and ask for the old paths, ‘Where is the good way?’ and walk in it, and you…
“Enter in by the narrow gate; for wide is the gate and broad is the way that leads to destruction, and many are those…
How narrow is the gate, and restricted is the way that leads to life! Few are those who find it.
Jesus said to him, “I am the way, the truth, and the life. No one comes to the Father, except through me.

translations.web: Then you will understand righteousness and justice, equity and every good path.
translations.bsb: Then you will discern righteousness and justice and equity—every good path.
translations.kjv: Then shalt thou understand righteousness, and judgment, and equity; yea, every good path.
translations.asv: Then shalt thou understand righteousness and justice, And equity, yea, every good path.
